title: The City Science Museum
focus: Can / can't; prepositions of place; superlatives

lines.text: Welcome to the City Science Museum. This is your audio guide.
The museum opens at ten o'clock and closes at five.
On the ground floor, you can see old computers and robots.
Please don't touch the robots. They are very expensive.
The space room is on the second floor. It's the biggest room in the museum.
Children's workshops start at eleven. They are free for students.
The café is next to the exit. It sells sandwiches and fruit.
You can't take photos with a flash.
Enjoy your visit!

title: Joining the Gym

lines.text: Welcome to FitZone. Can I help you?
Yes, I want to join the gym. How much is a membership?
A monthly membership is thirty dollars. A yearly membership is two hundred and fifty dollars.
The monthly one is cheaper. I'll take that.
Good choice. Do you want to use the swimming pool too?
Yes, please. Is there an extra cost?
No, the pool is free for members. But you must bring a towel.
OK. What time does the gym open?
It opens at six in the morning and closes at ten at night.
Great. Can I start today?
Yes. First, please fill in this form.

title: Two Tickets, Please

lines.text: Next, please. How can I help?

It's fourteen dollars for one ticket, so twenty-eight dollars for two.
Here you are. Can I pay by card?
Of course. Would you like popcorn?
Yes, a large one with salt, please. And two bottles of water.
OK. The film is two hours long and there are no breaks.
Thanks. Is the cinema near the bus stop?
Yes, the bus stop is just across the road.

title: A Flat Tyre

lines.text: Hi. What's the problem with your bike?

Oh, and your chain is dirty. You should clean it every month.

title: News About the School Trip

lines.text: Good morning, everyone. I have some news about the school trip.
Our class is going to the science park on Friday.
The bus leaves from the school gate at eight fifteen.
Please arrive by eight o'clock. We can't wait for late students.
Bring a packed lunch and a bottle of water. There is no shop at the park.
Wear comfortable shoes because we are going to walk about five kilometres.
The trip costs twelve pounds, and you must pay by Wednesday.
If it rains, we're going to visit the museum instead.
Ask your teacher if you have any questions. Thank you!

title: An Exchange Student in Canada

lines.text: Today we're talking to Andrés, an exchange student from Colombia.
Hello! Thanks for inviting me.
How long are you staying in Canada?
I'm staying for one year. I arrived in August.
Where do you live?
I live with a host family. They have two children and a dog.
What is different here?
The food is different, and the winter is much colder than in Bogotá.
Do you miss your home?
A little, but I talk to my family every Sunday on video call.
What do you like most about school?
The sports. I'm in the swimming team now.

title: My Mornings in a New City

lines.text: I'm Ella, and I'm a university student in a new city.
My mornings are always busy.
I usually get up at six thirty, and I never use my phone before breakfast.
First, I make coffee and eat toast with jam.
Then I walk to the bus stop. It takes about ten minutes.
The bus is often late, so I sometimes ride my bike.
My first class starts at eight forty-five.
On Fridays I don't have classes, so I sleep until nine.
After class, I always have lunch with my friend Daniel.
I love my new life here.
